text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not a big deal… My temples just hurt a little…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Tch. Maybe it was a bit chilly yesterday after I got out of the bath…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I should have dried my hair right away before the night air touched it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Imagine Brian's hair flowing in the night breeze…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ngh?! It's echoing… in my skull…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's headache continues for a while after.
